OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) DERIVED FROM THE SCHEMA: when the refused word matches an edge type's name by stem (governs to GOVERNED_BY, satisfies to SATISFIES), the refusal names the tool that draws it and the direction. No hand-kept synonym list. Cheap.
(b) A hand-kept map of common words to tools. It covers words no edge name contains, but it is the maintained-by-hand list that drifts.
(c) Do not cut the glosses mid-list: say "N more; describe_schema has them". Separate and cheap, and it removes the reporter's "cut off mid-list".

COUNTERPOINT: a pointer must not be read as permission to draw an edge the caller has not judged. It names the tool; it never draws.
